thread:
maria (external-auditor): Hi team — auditor ask: can you provide the evidence trail for RBAC changes that triggered during the Q4 rotation window and the KMS key rotation proof linked to those changes? They want mapping to SOC2 control CC6.1 and an explanation of automated notification workflow. Need sample logs and where the artifacts live.

lina (eng-security): Sure — can you confirm timeframe? Q4 rotation window = 2025-10-01 to 2025-10-07?

maria (external-auditor): yes that window is fine, also if you have any linked vuln triage or incident tickets that resulted from those changes include them.

lina (eng-security): OK. Quick summary: RBAC change requests go through PR -> approvals in repo infra/roles -> deploy pipeline creates iam change event -> we emit change metadata to our audit-log service and S3 evidence bucket. KMS key rotations are async via KMS-scheduler; rotation events are recorded in cloudtrail and mirrored to splunk. I will gather specific queries and artifact paths.

chris (infra): For exact logs, use these Splunk queries: 
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=UpdateAssumeRolePolicy OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventName=PutRolePolicy userIdentity.principalId=* roleName=* earliest=10/01/2025:00:00:00 latest=10/07/2025:23:59:59 | table _time, userIdentity.userName, eventName, requestParameters, sourceIPAddress
```
And for KMS rotations: 
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=EnableKeyRotation OR eventName=DisableKeyRotation OR eventName=RotateKey resource.type=KMSKey earliest=10/01/2025 latest=10/07/2025 | table _time, eventName, requestParameters.keyId, userIdentity.userName
```
Add filter `| stats count by requestParameters.keyId` to show occurrences.

lina (eng-security): Artefacts are staged here: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/q4-2025/rbac-kms/ — contains csv exports, signed manifests, and the crosswalk doc mapping log entries to control IDs. I uploaded a preliminary manifest: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/q4-2025/rbac-kms/manifest-2025-10-08.json (it includes checksums and extraction steps).

sam (platform): deploy-bot just created a snapshot for the window: deploy-bot: snapshot created: compliance-snapshot-2025-10-08-001 (stored in evidence-bucket). We also attached ticket references: PLAT-4321 (RBAC PR), SEC-298 (vuln triage).

maria (external-auditor): Great — can you paste small extracts of the log lines that prove who approved the role change and the KMS key rotation event? Need redacted user identifiers allowed.

lina (eng-security): Pasting sanitized extracts below (redacted):
```
_time: 2025-10-03T14:12:09Z | userName: lina-engineering | eventName: AttachRolePolicy | roleName: service-data-readers | requestParameters: {"policyArn":"arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess"}
_time: 2025-10-03T14:12:21Z | userName: chris-infra | eventName: PutRolePolicy | roleName: service-data-readers | requestParameters: {"policyDocument":"<redacted>"}
```
And KMS rotation extract: 
```
_time: 2025-10-05T03:00:01Z | userName: kms-scheduler | eventName: EnableKeyRotation | requestParameters.keyId: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345 | detail: rotation enabled
```
Those map to S3 exports named `cloudtrail-rbac-2025-10-01-10-07.csv` and `cloudtrail-kms-2025-10-01-10-07.csv`.

chris (infra): For control mapping, we added a crosswalk doc linking each event to control text: see s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/q4-2025/rbac-kms/control-crosswalk-v1.xlsx — column A = event link, B = control ID, C = narrative. Example mapping: AttachRolePolicy -> CC6.1 -> "Access provisioning with approval and audit trail."

maria (external-auditor): Thanks. One more: auditor wants confirmation that emergency/override RBAC changes (if any) during that window had JIRA tickets and post-facto approval notes. Any overrides?

sam (platform): There was one emergency change on 2025-10-06 to unblock a production job, ticket PLAT-4359. It has post-approval logged in SEC-299 and a retrospective in PLAT-4359-RETRO document in the evidence bucket. I will attach the ticket and the approval email thread to the manifest.

lina (eng-security): I'm assembling a short package: 1) exports (cloudtrail CSVs), 2) signed manifest (sha256 checksums), 3) control crosswalk, 4) ticket links and retrospective, 5) sanitized log extracts. ETA 2 hours.

maria (external-auditor): Perfect. Please also include how alerts are generated if an RBAC change affects key usage (i.e., KMS access). We need the detection rule and an example alert.

chris (infra): Detection rule (Splunk) we use: 
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventName=PutRolePolicy OR eventName=EnableKeyRotation | lookup kms-access-mapping keyId OUTPUT owner,prod_owner | where owner="prod-team" AND (eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventName=PutRolePolicy) | stats count by userIdentity.userName, eventName
```
Alert fires to #eng-security and creates SEC ticket via webhook. Example alert (sanitized): "RBAC change affecting KMS key arn:aws:kms:... by user chris-infra — ticket SEC-301 created".

deploy-bot: compliance-snapshot-2025-10-08-001 uploaded to s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/q4-2025/rbac-kms/; manifest signed by deploy-bot-key-id: db-7f2a.

maria (external-auditor): That's excellent. Once you upload the package, I'll validate checksums and sample the crosswalk. If anything else comes up I'll ping here. :thumbsup:

lina (eng-security): Upload complete. Link: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/q4-2025/rbac-kms/package-q4-2025.tar.gz. Manifest and checksums in the same folder. Tagging SEC folks to confirm: @chris (infra) @sam (platform).

chris (infra): confirmed. I added audit notes to PLAT-4321 and SEC-298.

maria (external-auditor): Received. I'll start validation now and follow up if I need raw event contexts. Thanks everyone.
